author: factornotes
title: Looking for Illustrator for Stationery
content:
At Factor Notes, we love turning creative ideas into visuals that inspire, connect and tell a story.

We’re looking for a talented and detail-oriented Illustrator to join our team and create original artwork for our stationery collections and brand campaigns. If you have a passion for illustration, a distinctive creative approach and an eye for bringing concepts to life through visuals, we’d love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do:
Illustration & Artwork: Create original illustrations and artwork for our stationery, planners, product collections and brand campaigns.
Concept Development: Develop creative concepts, patterns, characters and visual elements that align with our brand identity.
Team Collaboration: Collaborate with the design, content and marketing teams to develop visuals that tell a cohesive brand story.
Creative Exploration: Experiment with illustration styles and contribute fresh ideas for product launches, seasonal collections and marketing campaigns.

Who You Are:
Experienced: Have 0–3 years of experience in illustration or a related creative field, supported by a strong portfolio of original work.
Technical Proficiency: Be proficient in digital illustration tools such as Adobe Illustrator and Procreate.
Creative Expertise: Have a strong understanding of colour theory, composition and visual storytelling, along with excellent attention to detail.

Interested in joining our team? Mail your resume and portfolio to: careers@factornotes.com
